mapper.select: SELECT mm.id AS membership_id, mm.product_id, mp.name AS product_name, mp.product_type, mm.start_date, mm.end_date, GREATEST( DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, CURRENT_DATE), 0 ) AS remaining_days, mm.remaining_pt_sessions, CASE WHEN mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.end_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE mm.status END AS status, mm.created_at FROM member_memberships mm JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id WHERE mm.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY mm.start_date DESC, mm.id DESC

SELECT mm.id AS membership_id, mm.product_id, mp.name AS product_name, mp.product_type, mm.start_date, mm.end_date, GREATEST( DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, CURRENT_DATE), 0 ) AS remaining_days, mm.remaining_pt_sessions, CASE WHEN mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.end_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE mm.status END AS status, mm.created_at FROM member_memberships mm JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id WHERE mm.member_id = #{memberId} AND mm.id = #{membershipId}
SELECT id AS product_id, name, product_type, duration_days, price, pt_session_count FROM membership_products WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY product_type, duration_days, price
SELECT id, name, product_type, duration_days, price, pt_session_count, status FROM membership_products WHERE id = #{productId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT id, name, product_type, duration_days, price, pt_session_count, status FROM membership_products ORDER BY status, product_type, duration_days, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership_products (name, product_type, duration_days, price, pt_session_count, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{productType}, #{durationDays}, #{price}, #{ptSessionCount}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE membership_products SET name = #{request.name}, product_type = #{request.productType}, duration_days = #{request.durationDays}, price = #{request.price}, pt_session_count = #{request.ptSessionCount}, status = #{request.status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{productId}
